usage: effgen [-h] [--version] [-v] [-q] [--log-file LOG_FILE] [--no-animation]
              [--theme {default,high-contrast,monochrome,light}] [--completion {bash,zsh,fish}]
              {run,resume,sessions,runs,chat,code,serve,top,monitor,config,tools,models,examples,health,doctor,create-plugin,presets,quickstart,tutorial,workflow,batch,eval,compare,battle,debug,cost,report,prompts,loadtest}
              ...

effGen v1.0.0 - CLI for agent framework

positional arguments:
  {run,resume,sessions,runs,chat,code,serve,top,monitor,config,tools,models,examples,health,doctor,create-plugin,presets,quickstart,tutorial,workflow,batch,eval,compare,battle,debug,cost,report,prompts,loadtest}
                        Command to run
    run                 Run an agent with a task
    resume              Resume an interrupted agent run from a saved checkpoint snapshot (distinct
                        from a conversation session — see `--session-id`)
    sessions            Browse and manage saved conversations
    runs                Browse agent run history
    chat                Interactive chat mode
    code                Coding agent: writes code, runs it, and fixes what fails
    serve               Start API server
    top                 Live terminal view of runs, traffic, spend and GPU
    monitor             Alias for `effgen top`
    config              Configuration management
    tools               Tool management
    models              Model management
    examples            Run example scripts
    health              Check effGen infrastructure health (contacts external services)
    doctor              Check provider keys, the system, and what effgen code needs
    create-plugin       Generate a plugin project scaffold
    presets             List available agent presets
    quickstart          Guided first run: pick a model, run an agent, then write and run code
    tutorial            Alias of quickstart — the same guided first run
    workflow            Run a DAG-based workflow
    batch               Run batch queries from a file
    eval                Evaluate an agent against a test suite
    compare             Compare multiple models on a test suite
    battle              Race several models on one prompt, side by side
    debug               Run an agent in interactive debug mode
    cost                View cost spend and manage budgets
    report              Render a saved run/compare/eval/cost/loadtest JSON result as an HTML
                        report
    prompts             Prompt library management
    loadtest            Run a load test against a local mock or a live provider

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit
  -v, --verbose         Verbose output (show DEBUG/INFO logs)
  -q, --quiet           Quiet output (errors only)
  --log-file LOG_FILE   Log file path
  --no-animation        Disable live spinners/progress animation (also via NO_COLOR or
                        EFFGEN_NO_ANIM=1)
  --theme {default,high-contrast,monochrome,light}
                        Color theme for terminal output (also via EFFGEN_THEME). high-contrast
                        targets low-vision readers; monochrome keeps structure without hue;
                        NO_COLOR still turns color off entirely
  --completion {bash,zsh,fish}
                        Print shell completion script and exit

Examples:
  effgen run "What is 25 * 17?" --model Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct
  effgen run "Summarize quantum computing" -m gpt-5-nano --provider openai
  effgen run "Tell me a joke" -m groq:llama-3.1-8b-instant
  effgen chat -m gpt-5-nano --provider openai
  effgen models list                 # provider registry overview
  effgen models list --provider groq # full per-model detail
  effgen doctor --live --cheap       # confirm providers are actually usable
  effgen tools list

Model id formats:
  - Local HuggingFace repo:   Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct
  - Provider-prefixed:        openai:gpt-5-nano   groq:llama-3.1-8b-instant
  - Bare id + --provider:     -m gpt-5-nano --provider openai
  Providers: openai, anthropic, gemini, cerebras, groq, together,
             fireworks, replicate, hf
